# `combine-identical-switch-prongs`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports adjacent switch prongs with identical bodies and no payload capture.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

One comma-separated prong makes shared behavior explicit and removes duplicated
branch bodies.

## When it fires

Bodies must be textually identical and comment-free. Captured payloads are
excluded because their compatibility requires type information.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn run(n: u8) u8 {
    return switch (n) {
        0 => 1,
        1 => 1,
        else => 2,
    };
}
```
